note: Product-level signal pack. Session expiry, maintenance interstitials and app crashes are properties of the VENDOR PRODUCT, not of any one capability -- so they are curated once here and merged into every capability recorded against cucore, rather than rediscovered per flow. A discovery run only sees the exceptional states that happen to occur while it is running; this is where the ones an operations team already knows about live.

signals.description: The application returned an unhandled server exception.
The back-office session timed out; sign on again and rebuild navigation state.
An unscheduled maintenance notice interposed itself; acknowledge and carry on.

target.description: the Continue button on the System Notice interstitial

signals.description: The member number does not exist at this institution. A legitimate answer, not a failure.

outcome.message: No member with that number exists at this institution.

signals.description: The core rejected the opening deposit as below the product minimum. Curated here after a discovery run proposed a detector that matched the permanent "min $25.00" hint beside the field rather than the rejection message -- the compiler caught it, and this is the corrected version.

when.text_matches: Opening deposit must be at least \$([0-9.]+)

outcome.message: The opening deposit is below this product's minimum.

signals.description: The service operator lacks the entitlement for this action.

outcome.message: The automation operator is not entitled to perform this action.

fingerprintNote: Asserted once at the start of every replay of every capability on this product. It answers 'is this still the software we recorded against?'. A mismatch is FLAGGED, not fatal: one institution upgrading ahead of the rest is exactly the thing you want to hear about on the day it happens rather than the morning a hundred replays break, and refusing to work would be a worse answer than working and saying so.
